content.class.neighbour.blurb: 温娜老太托邻居照看她的小屋，顺便把她锁了好些年的花园打开。
content.class.neighbour.kit.0.name: 手杖
content.class.neighbour.name: 邻居
content.fx.the-latch.oc.lift-the-latch.2.narrate: 门闩咔哒一声抬起，通往花园的铁门转开了。
content.fx.trig.the-yard.0.narrate: 这是温娜的院子。她的字条上说，开花园的门闩在里屋，穿过厨房就到。
content.obj.the-garden.step-out.title: 走进花园
content.obj.the-latch.lift-the-latch.hint: 穿过院门、厨房和那扇橡木门。门闩的拉杆在里屋地上，干草捆旁边。
content.obj.the-latch.lift-the-latch.title: 抬起里屋的门闩
content.quest.the-latch.goal: 穿过院门进屋，推开橡木门到里屋，抬起门闩，打开通往花园的铁门。
content.world.outro: 铁门敞开着，老花园随你走走。
content.world.title: 门闩

source.class.neighbour.blurb: Old Wenna asked a neighbour to mind her cottage and to open the garden she has kept locked for years.
source.class.neighbour.kit.0.name: Walking stick
source.class.neighbour.name: Neighbour
source.fx.the-latch.oc.lift-the-latch.2.narrate: The latch lifts with a clank, and the iron door to the garden swings open.
source.fx.trig.the-yard.0.narrate: Wenna's yard. Her note said the latch for the garden is in the back room, past the kitchen.
source.obj.the-garden.step-out.hint: Go out through the iron door.
source.obj.the-garden.step-out.title: Walk out into the garden
source.obj.the-latch.lift-the-latch.hint: Through the yard gate, the kitchen and the oak door. The latch lever is on the back room's floor, by the hay.
source.obj.the-latch.lift-the-latch.title: Lift the latch in the back room
source.quest.the-garden.goal: Go out through the iron door into the garden.
source.quest.the-latch.goal: Go through the yard gate and into the cottage, through the oak door to the back room, and lift the latch that opens the iron door to the garden.
source.world.outro: The iron door stands open, and the old garden is yours to walk.
source.world.title: The Latch
